fixture_kind: synthetic model/host replay cases, not chain captures
scope: Feed each input and question to the skill and assess its response/actions against required and forbidden criteria. No collector is implemented here. Supplied observations are hypothetical; these cases do not prove deployed behavior, live provider recovery, host timing, ABI equivalence or settlement enforcement.
conventions: All monetary raw values are decimal strings. Addresses, block IDs, transaction IDs and revision IDs in inputs are synthetic unless a field explicitly supplies a public source URL. Missing evidence stays unknown. Budget counters include recovery attempts; they are replay inputs, not measured runs.
